_comment: Character classes from the Blade & Sigil design doc. Arrays are indexed by level: index 0 = level 1, index 19 = level 20. SPELL POINTS (magic v2, doc formula): casters use "spell_points": {"base": N, "multiplier": M} — max SP = base + (level x multiplier x 3), so a Wizard (4, 1.0) has 7 SP at level 1 and 64 at level 20. A legacy per-level array still works; classes with neither have no magic. hit_bonus applies to attack AND damage rolls. GEAR: 'starting_weapon' is an item id from items.json. 'weapon_types' lists the weapon categories the class may wield (or ["any"]); 'armor_types' lists light/med/heavy; 'shields' allows a shield. These enforce the design doc's item rules. 'detect': per-level % chance (design doc tables, thief & archer) to notice secret doors and traps — the party uses its best detector, +5% per point of DEX modifier, +race detect_bonus. 'disarms': true lets the class defuse a DETECTED trap by stepping onto it (thieves only, per the doc). | "locked": true hides a class from character creation until its progression lanes are built (2026-08-26: archer/spellblade/summoner wait; delete the flag to release one). | Itemization v2: 'robe' in armor_types is the armor_robe category (scholar's robes) — every class wears them, including mages. | MAGIC v3 (2026-08-28): 'caster': arcane | divine says which school a class works in — ARCANE casters may READ scrolls in battle. A 'spellbook' block makes the class keep a spellbook FROM LEVEL 1: 'starting_spells' (the kit every new hero opens with), 'study_levels' (each listed level grants one free STUDY pick of any common class spell of castable level — arrives as a card on the map), 'slots_base' (+ max spell level + one per 'extra_slot_levels' reached = prepared spells at a time). 'revelation_levels' (priests): {spell level: character level} — the RARE prayers of that level are revealed automatically on reaching it. | NEW CLASSES (2026-08-29, companion doc v1): 'magic': 'lane' = the fixed-list half-caster model (Spellblade, Stoneshaper) — before the fork the hero knows only the creation-gift spell (if the gift is a spell), else the class's 'starting_spells' list, else every level-1 lane spell; from the fork on, every spell tagged with their lane in spells.json as its level opens (a swapped-out Stance is exchanged free). Level-1 lane spells are STANCES (spells.json 'stance': flat SP cost, lasts until the next full rest); the rest cost the standard level x 2 + 1. 'spell_cost': {per_level, base} may still override the formula for a class (unused since the v1.1 playtest revision). 'creation_pick' = a level-1 gift chosen in character creation: options carry 'spell' (known from level 1), 'detect' (+% trap/secret skill), or 'ac_vs_element' (+AC vs one element chosen at creation). | RANGER (2026-08-29): the Archer class is DROPPED (doc ruling); see the ranger entry's comment for spell_unlocks / dual_wield / point_blank_penalty / favored_enemy. | 'scroll_gamble' {chance, school} (designer ruling 2026-09-03): this class may TRY to read a scroll of that school without being a caster — 'chance'% it works, and the scroll BURNS either way. The level it may attempt is what a real caster of the same character level could CAST (one tier tighter than a caster's own reading, which reaches a level higher). The Thief's classic gamble.

thief.name: Thief
thief._stealthy_comment: stealthy: begins every fight the PARTY starts hidden in the shadows (monsters cannot see or target them until they strike) — the engine's rule for how a Blade Work rogue reaches an unaware mark

spellblade.name: Spellblade
spellblade._comment: Elven Spellblade (companion doc v1, 2026-08-29; playtest revision v1.1 2026-08-30): a half-caster whose whole spell list is self-buffs. High Elf only. Group B hit/dmg, d8 HP, mage AC, spell points from a per-level table (the generic formula overshoots). 'magic': 'lane' = a FIXED spell list decided by the level-5 lane (spells.json 'lane' field) — no book, no study, no picks. COSTS: the level-1 verse is a STANCE (1 SP flat, lasts until the next full rest — spells.json 'stance'); levels 2-5 are SURGES at the doc's standard level x 2 + 1 (5/7/9/11 SP). 'creation_pick' = the level-1 Stance chosen in character creation: the hero knows only that verse before the fork; if the level-5 lane sings the other one, it is swapped for free. SP TABLE (designer ruling 2026-08-30): raised from the doc's 2…10 to 3…14 so every Surge is castable the level its tier opens with the Stance still held — 5 SP at level 4 (tier 2), 8 at 8 (tier 3), 10 at 12 (tier 4), 12 at 16 (tier 5), 14 at 20.

creation_pick.title: A first song
creation_pick.blurb: Every Spellblade is taught one Stance before the road forks — a verse sung once after each rest that lasts the whole way. Which?

options.name: Edge of Dawn
options.blurb: The blade-verse Stance: +1 to hit and +1 damage until your next full rest, for 1 SP.

options.name: Aegis of Dawn
options.blurb: The ward-verse Stance: +1 AC and +1 on every save until your next full rest, for 1 SP.

stoneshaper._comment: Dwarven Stoneshaper (companion doc v1, 2026-08-29; playtest revision v1.1 2026-08-30). 'starting_spells' = the verses known BEFORE the level-5 fork (Skin of Stone, the self-only Stance, is what every Stoneshaper casts through levels 1-4); at the fork the lane's list takes over — Bulwark keeps Skin of Stone, Hearthstone swaps it (free) for the ally-targeting Stonekin's Blessing. COSTS: the level-1 verse is a STANCE (1 SP flat, until the next full rest); levels 2-5 are SURGES at the standard level x 2 + 1 (5/7/9/11 SP). The creation gift (Stonespeak / Ironward) is a passive, independent of the spells. SP TABLE (designer ruling 2026-08-30): raised from the doc's 2…10 to 3…14 so every Surge is castable the level its tier opens with the Stance still held — 5 SP at level 4 (tier 2), 8 at 8 (tier 3), 10 at 12 (tier 4), 12 at 16 (tier 5), 14 at 20.
stoneshaper.name: Stoneshaper

creation_pick.title: Stone-gift
creation_pick.blurb: Every Stoneshaper carries one gift of the deep places from the first day. Which?

options.name: Stonespeak
options.blurb: Stonecunning: +10% to notice traps and secret doors (the stone tells you).

options.name: Ironward
options.blurb: +1 AC against creatures that attack with one element — choose fire, frost, lightning, or poison.

ranger._comment: Half-Elven Ranger (companion doc v1, 2026-08-29 — REPLACES the Archer, which is dropped). Half-Elf only. Group A hit/dmg (the Warrior's schedule), d8 HP, AC +1 every 3 levels, the Archer's attack progression and tracking (detect) column. A QUARTER CASTER: 'spell_unlocks' says spell level 1 opens at character level 9 and level 2 at 15 — the universal max-spell-level table does NOT apply; the SP column is empty until 9. 'magic': 'lane' (fixed list; the five Ranger spells carry no lane tag so both lanes know them). 'dual_wield': ONLY this class may hold two one-handed weapons — the off-hand swings once per round at −'penalty' to hit (lanes/refinements whittle it down). 'point_blank_penalty' 2 overrides the ranged default (4) — hunter's reflexes. 'favored_enemy': at each of 'levels' choose a monster family (+1 hit/dmg vs it) or deepen a known one, 'cap' 3 max; the first pick happens in character creation. 'creation_pick' knacks: 'free_swaps' (W swaps that cost no turn, per battle), 'recover_all' + 'quiver_bonus' (Fletcher).
ranger.name: Ranger

scouting.name: Scouting
scouting.blurb: The Ranger keeps watch on the trail. When a monster the party can see closes to arm's reach, the Ranger rolls their skill: on a success it halts at the edge of the torchlight and the party acts first — no ambush.

creation_pick.title: A knack
creation_pick.blurb: Every Ranger learned one trick before the wild taught the rest. Which?

options.name: Quickdraw
options.blurb: Once per battle, swapping between bow and blades (W) costs no turn.

options.name: Fletcher
options.blurb: After a won fight recover ALL missed arrows, not half; the quiver holds 12 more.
